Generate a modular PIXEL ART PLAYER BODY sprite sheet for a 2D side-view fantasy game. First attachment is the CURRENT PLAYER, the identity reference; second attachment is the EXISTING CREATURE STYLE to match. Preserve the player's recognizable short brown hair, light warm skin, rust-red scarf, moss/olive green tunic, diagonal tan leather chest strap, brown belt, dark trousers, brown boots, and short muted green cape. Improve its craftsmanship and shading to match the chunky, shaded fantasy sprites in the second reference. Human adventurer proportions, not a large-headed chibi. Side view facing RIGHT in every pose. Same face, hair, costume and size across all cells. Head remains virtually identical.
CRITICAL: THIS IS THE BODY LAYER ONLY. NO ARMS, NO HANDS, NO ELBOWS, NO HELD ITEMS, NO WEAPONS, NO SHIELDS. Arms and weapons are separate game layers and will be drawn later. Draw a complete head/neck/torso/hips/two legs, with a clean seamless torso contour at the shoulders, no projecting sleeves, no shoulder holes, no injury or stumps. The short cape is behind the torso and does not resemble an arm. The torso must be fully painted behind future arms.
Exactly SIX sprites in TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, evenly sized cells, canvas 1024x1536. No labels, border, ground, shadows or effects. Flat uniform background #1e2f37. Crisp deliberately chunky pixel clusters suitable for a roughly 48x64 native sprite, limited consistent palette, NO smooth painting or antialias blur. Feet aligned at 88% height of every cell, head at same height, body centered.
Read left to right top to bottom:
1 IDLE: relaxed body, both feet planted close, head faces right.
2 WALK LEFT CONTACT: near LEFT leg stretches FAR FORWARD to the right, far RIGHT leg far back to the left; wide split.
3 WALK FIRST PASSING: feet close beneath pelvis, near LEFT leg supports weight, far RIGHT knee bent lifting its boot forward.
4 WALK RIGHT CONTACT: far RIGHT leg stretches FAR FORWARD to the right, near LEFT leg far back to the left; wide split OPPOSITE to pose 2.
5 WALK SECOND PASSING: feet close beneath pelvis, far RIGHT leg supports weight, near LEFT knee bent lifting its boot forward.
6 JUMP: knees bent lightly beneath body, feet raised, head and outfit unchanged.
Near left leg stays lighter and far right leg stays darker across ALL poses so they actually exchange leading roles. It is a modular body sprite sheet with no arms in any cell.
dragon:
Generate a new PIXEL ART design candidate for the CINDERJAW SKELETON DRAGON in a 2D side-view fantasy game. Attachment 1 is the CURRENT DRAGON and is the identity/silhouette reference. Attachment 2 is the new creature roster's art style, especially the ivory bone guard. Preserve the dragon identity: entirely skeletal, weathered ivory bones with dark warm brown outlines/shadows, exposed rib cage and vertebrae, long bony tail curving behind it, angular toothy dragon skull, small amber ember eye, four clawed walking legs, a pair of raised skeletal wings made of bare bone fingers. NO skin, flesh, scales, feathers, wing membrane or armor. Keep the side-on RIGHT-facing, low forward-pointing skull and large angular raised wing silhouette from the old dragon. It must read as a skeletal dragon, not a dinosaur without wings or a living dragon.
Match the new roster's stronger silhouette, substantial readable bone clusters, restrained highlights and layered depth. Avoid spindly disconnected sticks, overly smooth illustration, tiny line noise and excessive realistic detail. Design should survive reduction to about 112x80 native pixels; deliberately chunky pixels and limited palette, crisp dark outlines and clear gaps between ribs and wing bones. Keep the same head and skeletal anatomy in every pose. Far legs/wings are darker, near legs/wings lighter.
Exactly FOUR whole-body sprites on a 1024x1024 canvas in a TWO COLUMN by TWO ROW grid. All have the same scale, rightward orientation, center/pelvis alignment and foot baseline. Allow clear padding so tail, wing tips and jaw never touch a cell edge. Flat solid background #1e2f37. No labels, text, borders, landscape, ground shadow, particles, fire, breath clouds or flying projectiles. The game creates all emitted effects separately.
1 TOP LEFT: neutral standing idle, jaws closed, readable four legs, raised bone wings, tail extending left.
2 TOP RIGHT: bite anticipation, skull retracts slightly, jaw opens, chest braces, feet stay planted.
3 BOTTOM LEFT: bite release, skull reaches forward and jaws snap nearly shut, a clear forward thrust but same skull proportions; no effects.
4 BOTTOM RIGHT: sustained fire-breath body pose, neck extends horizontally forward and jaw stays open, ribs and throat show only a subtle ember-colored interior accent. NO FIRE outside the mouth. Feet brace steadily.
This is a visual candidate for comparison, not a finished full animation set. Prioritize character consistency and readable pixel craftsmanship.
